issues.basis: Immutable original-brief.json identifying_features[2] and factual-acceptance explicitly say the stem has subtle oval leaf bases; this is not a new requirement for ligules or microscopic anatomy.
issues.finding: Fresh source measurement shows a stem of only six circular16-vertex rings,184 six-vertex pointed leaf blades, and72 ovoid bodies confined to the upper fertile zone. The vegetative stem has no oval leaf-base relief. Exact-GLB detail confirms pointed green insertions into a featureless stem.
issues.required_repair: Add restrained oval foliar-base geometry appropriate to the documented leaf bases, without creating raised diamond cushions or copying exaggerated concept nodules. Preserve the unbranched habit, rounded root base and continuous alternating fertile regions.

original_concept.observation: Actual concept shows an unbranched plant, broad pointed leaves, rounded base and conspicuous oval stem marks. Narrowing leaves was documented; deleting all subtle oval stem leaf bases was not part of the frozen scope.

views.observation: Single narrow leafy axis and rounded/faceted basal swelling are clear. The continuous upper fertile zone is not a separate cone.
Opposite oblique retains the unbranched architecture and rooted base, with no large detached organs.
Proximal foliage grades into a slender upper spire; stem leaf-base relief required by the brief is not resolved.
Narrow blades remain volumetric; no branching or diamond cushions are present.
Rear view retains the continuous unbranched taper, but offers no evidence of the required oval leaf bases.
The radial plant is small at the common full-height framing; this view cannot establish reproductive microanatomy.
Basic corm, roots and leafy axis survive removal of material color. Stem remains smooth between pointed leaf insertions.
Unbranched silhouette and radial roots read clearly. This does not compensate for the missing named surface feature.

dimensional_interpretation: Original bbox values are explicitly nominal art-planning targets, not hard bounds. Dimensional parameter variations disclosed in revision history are not silently promoted to hard equalities. Named morphology/component counts and budget ceilings remain required. Actual world component bounds are in source-geometry-reexport report.
limitations: No formal,user,site,release or live approval. GPU and composed scene remain unrun.
